method: Seeded layered SVG from hand-drawn archetypes, rasterized to generated @4 PNG masters; source:raster zone pages

source.encoding: every PNG re-encoded by scripts/png-canonical.mjs (pako 2.1.0: RGBA8, filter 0, deflate level 9, no ancillary chunks)

reference.use: Manually drawn ceiling needles, branching rust, angular rubble, low boulders and pointed crystal clusters at the board's tile scale; no reference pixels used by the generator

notes: Three selectable styles; seeded changes move facet junctions without replacing the authored contours with noise.
